simple.summary: מִגְדַּל־אֵל (Migdal-ʼÊl) means Migdal-El , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 38.

definitions.full: H4027. Migdal -el מִגְדַּלאֵֿל proper name ( tower of God ) stronghold in Naphtali Josh 19:38 probably = Μαγδαλά Matt 15:39 = Mejdel in the plain of Gennesareth Rob BR iii. 298 Bd Pal 257 .
